lessonTitle: 49. Bringing fractions to a common denominator
lessonTitleEnglish: Bringing fractions to a common denominator
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: To give fractions a common denominator, use the LCM of their denominators.
stages.headlineEnglish: To give fractions a common denominator, use the LCM of their denominators.

stages.headline: The extra factor is the common denominator divided by the fraction's denominator.
stages.headlineEnglish: The extra factor is the common denominator divided by the fraction's denominator.

stages.headline: The same works for three or more fractions.
stages.headlineEnglish: The same works for three or more fractions.
